headline: Artemis Electricals sets October 23, 2026, as dividend record date
hook: Record date set for Artemis dividend
summary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited has announced October 23, 2026, as the record date for an upcoming dividend. Shareholders holding the company's shares as of this date will be eligible for the payout. This routine corporate action affects existing equity holders of the listed entity.
why_it_matters: Determines your eligibility for the upcoming Artemis dividend payout.

headline: Artemis Electricals and Projects reports AGM voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchange
summary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing by the company. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update holds minimal immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Artemis Electricals submits AGM scrutinizer report to the exchange
hook: Scrutinizer's report clears annual general meeting
summary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This routine compliance filing confirms the voting results and proceedings of the shareholder meeting. For an Indian retail investor, this is a standard administrative disclosure with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock price.
